violation_type.title: Screen Time Activities - May Supplement Activities Not Replace (26 TAC §744.2007(a))
violation_type.short_title: Screen Time Activities - May Supplement Activities Not Replace
violation_type.typical_finding: At the time of the inspection, children were allowed to use electronic devices for free play. It was observed that children were not viewing anything related to educational purposes.
